related.title: Unicode UTF-8：碼點、位元組與分段解碼
related.titleEn: Unicode UTF-8: code points, bytes and incremental decoding
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：研究5驗收：交付filter-bits.csv、oracle比較與非法刪除反例；理論值不是保證每次樣本比例。 請保留本研究的輸入、逐筆中間狀態與不符合條件時的處置。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 acceptance: Deliver filter-bits.csv, oracle comparisons and the invalid-deletion case; theoretical probability is not an exact sample-rate guarantee. Retain inputs, intermediate state and the disposition when the criterion is not met.
related.difference: 列每碼點U+值、UTF-8 hex與byte span；用增量decoder保留不完整序列，不逐chunk強制decode。
related.differenceEn: Record each U+ value, UTF-8 hex and span; use an incremental decoder to retain partial sequences instead of decoding chunks independently.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
標準Bloom filter允許false positive而無設計內false negative；清除共享bit可能導致false negative，因此刪除需其他設計。
本課數值核對：(1-exp(-7*100/1000))**7 = 0.00819372206586 probability；另一項核對：(1-exp(-7*200/1000))**7 = 0.137781707292 probability。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。

UTF-8使用1到4 bytes編碼Unicode scalar value；碼點數、byte數與使用者看到的字素數不相等。
本課數值核對：1+3+4 = 8 B；另一項核對：1+1+1 = 3 code_points。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
Standard Bloom filters allow false positives but no designed false negatives; clearing shared bits can create false negatives, so deletion needs another design.
Numeric audit: (1-exp(-7*100/1000))**7 = 0.00819372206586 probability; second audit: (1-exp(-7*200/1000))**7 = 0.137781707292 probability. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.

UTF-8 uses one to four bytes per Unicode scalar value; code-point, byte and user-perceived grapheme counts differ.
Numeric audit: 1+3+4 = 8 B; second audit: 1+1+1 = 3 code_points. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: gzip／DEFLATE：資料完整性與解壓邊界
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：研究5驗收：交付filter-bits.csv、oracle比較與非法刪除反例；理論值不是保證每次樣本比例。 請保留本研究的輸入、逐筆中間狀態與不符合條件時的處置。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 acceptance: Deliver filter-bits.csv, oracle comparisons and the invalid-deletion case; theoretical probability is not an exact sample-rate guarantee. Retain inputs, intermediate state and the disposition when the criterion is not met.
related.difference: 用標準gzip產生實際fixture，記實際壓縮大小而不強迫等於512；逐步限制輸出總量與member數。
related.differenceEn: Generate a real gzip fixture and record actual size without forcing512 bytes; bound output bytes and member count.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
標準Bloom filter允許false positive而無設計內false negative；清除共享bit可能導致false negative，因此刪除需其他設計。
本課數值核對：(1-exp(-7*100/1000))**7 = 0.00819372206586 probability；另一項核對：(1-exp(-7*200/1000))**7 = 0.137781707292 probability。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。

gzip封裝壓縮串流並有CRC32及ISIZE；CRC用於意外毀損偵測，不提供來源認證，ISIZE以2^32取餘。
本課數值核對：4096/512 = 8 ratio；另一項核對：(2**32+7)-2**32 = 7 ISIZE_B。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
Standard Bloom filters allow false positives but no designed false negatives; clearing shared bits can create false negatives, so deletion needs another design.
Numeric audit: (1-exp(-7*100/1000))**7 = 0.00819372206586 probability; second audit: (1-exp(-7*200/1000))**7 = 0.137781707292 probability. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.

gzip wraps compressed data with CRC32 and ISIZE; CRC detects accidental corruption rather than authenticating a source, and ISIZE is modulo2^32.
Numeric audit: 4096/512 = 8 ratio; second audit: (2**32+7)-2**32 = 7 ISIZE_B. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.
